days.title: Northern Marshes and River Delta
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Principina a Mare
stops.detail: The Park covers an area of 9800 hectares and extends along the coast from the village of Principina a Mare (municipality of Grosseto) to the village of Talamone (municipality of Orbetello).

stops.name: Foce dell'Ombrone
stops.detail: Within its territory lie the last marshy lands near the mouth of the Ombrone, which, rich in life and still wild, host important colonies of marsh birds.

stops.name: Fiume Ombrone
stops.detail: Limitation of negative impacts on fauna caused by direct human disturbance, through increased surveillance activity (particularly during migration and wintering periods), in regulated access areas; regulation of canoeing on the Ombrone River; adequate organization of guided tours (E).

stops.name: Fattoria di Spergolaia
stops.detail: Further south the area is composed of the Uccellina mountains covered by dense Mediterranean scrub and to the east, at the foot of the mountains, by vast grassy expanses, where the Fattoria di Spergolaia, administrative center of the regional farm and headquarters of the butteri, is located.

stops.name: Pianure di Maremma
stops.detail: Inside the Regional Park is the site of regional interest (SIR) "Pianure di Maremma": the area is also protected as a special protection zone (ZPS), and the SIR "Dune dell'Uccellina", also a site of community interest (SIC) and special protection zone (ZPS) and completely included in the Natural Park.
